findings.body: The volume mount binds `./.tinysweeper.toml` as the source. If this file does not exist in the repository (which is likely, as it appears to be a user-specific configuration), `docker compose up` will fail with a mount error. Consider documenting that the file must be created first, or use a different mechanism to provide the configuration.
findings.title: Make the config file mount optional or ensure the file exists

value.summary: The change corrects the GitHub App environment variable names and mounts a configuration file, but the mount requires a host file that may not exist, causing docker compose up to fail.
